# computesphere_spherelet_types (Data Source)

Lists the spherelet sizes a service or deployment can run on, with vCPU, memory and price. Pass `region` to check availability in one region.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    computesphere = {
      source  = "computesphere/computesphere"
      version = "~> 1.1"
    }
  }
}

variable "api_token" {
  description = "API token for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "account_id" {
  description = "Account ID for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
}

variable "api_url" {
  description = "API URL for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
  default     = "api.computesphere.com"
}

provider "computesphere" {
  api_token  = var.api_token  # or set COMPUTESPHERE_API_TOKEN env variable
  account_id = var.account_id # or set COMPUTESPHERE_ACCOUNT_ID env variable
  api_url    = var.api_url    # or set COMPUTESPHERE_API_URL env variable
}

data "computesphere_spherelet_types" "example" {
  region = var.region # optional: check availability in this region
}

variable "region" {
  description = "Region to check availability in"
  type        = string
  default     = "us-east-1"
}

output "available_sizes" {
  value = [for t in data.computesphere_spherelet_types.example.spherelet_types : "${t.name} (${t.id}): ${t.vcpu} vCPU, ${t.memory_mb} MB, $${t.monthly_price_usd}/mo" if t.available]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `region` (String) Check availability in this region, e.g. `us-east-1`.

### Read-Only

- `spherelet_types` (Attributes List) The spherelet sizes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spherelet_types))

<a id="nestedatt--spherelet_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spherelet_types`

Read-Only:

- `aliases` (List of String) Other names accepted as `spherelet_type` for this size, e.g. `MAX`.
- `annual_price_usd` (Number) Annual price in USD.
- `available` (Boolean) Whether the size can be ordered now (in `region`, when set).
- `cpu_guaranteed_vcpu` (Number) vCPU guaranteed at all times. Up to `vcpu` is used when spare CPU is available.
- `family` (String) Size family: `flex`, `standard` or `plus`.
- `id` (String) Size code to use as `spherelet_type`, e.g. `sl-1c-2g`.
- `memory_mb` (Number) Memory in MB.
- `monthly_price_usd` (Number) Monthly price in USD.
- `name` (String) Display name, e.g. `Standard 1`.
- `vcpu` (Number) vCPU; fractions are shared CPU.
